incident_summary: Payments API in Production is experiencing AKS pod CrashLoopBackOff, causing checkout failures for customers. Issue started shortly after a new deployment 30 minutes ago. Container exits immediately on startup. Incident is currently active.
missing_information: Specific error messages or stack traces from the pod logs
Details of what changed in the new deployment
Kubernetes event logs related to the pod
Whether the issue affects all pods or only some instances
possible_root_causes: Faulty code or configuration in the new deployment causing startup failure
Missing or misconfigured environment variables or secrets
Dependency service unavailability causing container exit
Container image corruption or tag mismatch
evidence_needed: Full pod logs including startup and error messages
Kubernetes events and describe output for the pod
Status and logs of dependent services
safe_validation_steps: Retrieve detailed pod logs using 'kubectl logs <pod_name> --previous'
Describe the pod with 'kubectl describe pod <pod_name>' to check events and failure reasons
Check Kubernetes events in the namespace for related errors
Review deployment configuration and recent changes without applying changes
Validate availability of dependent services and secrets
actions_to_avoid_first: Restarting or scaling pods before identifying root cause
Rolling back or redeploying without root cause analysis
Modifying pod resource limits or configuration on live production pods
recommended_next_action: Run 'kubectl logs <pod_name> --previous' and 'kubectl describe pod <pod_name>' to gather logs and events, review deployment manifests, and engage application development team for analysis.
escalation_message:
Subject: URGENT: Production Payments API AKS Pod CrashLoopBackOff – Checkout Failures (INC-001)

Team,

We have an active incident affecting the Payments API in Production. As of 10:15 AM, AKS pods are in CrashLoopBackOff resulting in checkout failures for customers. This issue started shortly after a new deployment 30 minutes ago.

Current logs indicate that the container exits immediately upon startup. We need immediate investigation into the pod logs, deployment changes, and any error messages for root cause analysis.

Please prioritize this incident and share findings from pod logs ('kubectl logs --previous'), pod description ('kubectl describe pod'), and deployment manifests.

No restarts or configuration changes should be done until more information is gathered.

Thank you,
[Your Name/Team]
